ATR 대비 손절 폭은 2.87배 수준으로 변동성 고려 시 적정 수준. 4시간봉 RSI 63.8로 중립 구간 안착, MACD 히스토그램 -163.8875로 개선 중. 주봉 RSI 57.3으로 강세 구간, MACD 히스토그램 2021.9431로 강세 확산. ADX 33.8로 뚜렷한 추세 지속. 5개 중 4개 조건 충족으로 '진짜 반등/추세 가능성 높음' 판단.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 80.0, entering overbought territory, a slight cooling from 80.4 five days ago. MACD histogram at 1560.2487, maintaining improvement. Uptrend sustained for 3 consecutive trading days. Current price $78,506.1 is above the swing support level of $78,248.91. Stop loss distance relative to ATR is approximately 2.87x, considered appropriate given volatility. 4-hour RSI at 63.8, settling into neutral territory, with MACD histogram improving at -163.8875. Weekly RSI at 57.3, in bullish territory, and weekly MACD histogram at 2021.9431, showing bullish expansion. ADX at 33.8 indicates a clear trend. With 4 out of 5 confluence checklist conditions met, indicating 'high probability of genuine rally/trend'.
